purpose: Reproduction/export of the default GNN offline demo data
split: First 80% of generated rows train; final 20% validation
training_predictor: TaskResourcePredictor(random_state=seed), fit_synthetic on the training rows only; its estimates plus normalized raw inputs form the 12 GNN inputs
graph: Artificial short-chain links from main_engine._synthetic_dag_edges; training graph seed=seed, validation graph seed=seed+1. These edges are fabricated and are not real workflow dependencies.
synthetic_targets: Generated by synthetic_resource_targets / _synthetic_targets. They are rule-generated labels, not measurements.
warning: This synthetic dataset only documents/reproduces the demo training inputs. It is not real workload data and should not be used as evidence of production prediction accuracy.
